subject.title: fix(clawhub): cap archive and clawpack download size at 256 MiB

question: Should OpenClaw accept a 256 MiB hard cap for ClawHub package, ClawPack, skill, resolver URL, and GitHub-backed skill archive downloads?
rationale: The implementation is a focused security hardening fix, but the cap changes successful behavior for any existing legitimate archive above that size.

options.title: Accept 256 MiB
options.body: Land this PR with the marketplace-aligned cap and treat oversized ClawHub archives as unsupported fail-fast downloads.

options.title: Tune The Limit
options.body: Change the cap and test expectations first if maintainers know legitimate ClawHub artifacts need a different ceiling.

options.title: Pause For Artifact Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if package, skill, manifest, and marketplace downloads need one broader documented artifact-size contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept 256 MiB
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the marketplace-aligned cap and treat oversized ClawHub archives as unsupported fail-fast downloads.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent verification trail on ClawHub response-body hardening and maintainer cap acceptance.
